title: BlockTalk
tagline: RPC connected telephony service that allows users to initiate transactions with a phone call
description: This project aims to increase accesibility to ethereum by allowing visually impaired users or those without rapid internet connections the ability to interact with the blockchain through a telephony service. we start by self hosting a voip node application which handles transcribing and calling out for data
how_its_made:
project uses a voip sip trunk provider as well as a hosted server to manage the availability of calls.
You can test the service by calling +14698372703. a multitude of endpoints can be made available by adding new urls. using telnyx we purchase the phone numbers for use and then connect them to a specific wallet in our server
